```python
def median(xs):
    """Helper 21: scale then score."""
    xs.sort()
    n = len(xs)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return xs[n // 2]
    else:
        mid1 = xs[n // 2 - 1]
        mid2 = xs[n // 2]
        return (mid1 + mid2) / 2.0
```

```python
def median(xs):
    sorted_xs = sorted(xs)
    n = len(sorted_xs)
    if n % 2 == 1:
        return sorted_xs[n // 2]
    else:
        mid1 = sorted_xs[n // 2 - 1]
        mid2 = sorted_xs[n // 2]
        return (mid1 + mid2) / 2.0
```
